# HMG Global Business Solutions SARL

> Djibouti-based B2B logistics, international sourcing & trading, and business setup consulting partner serving the Republic of Djibouti and the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor.

HMG Global Business Solutions SARL (founded and led by Managing Director Hamza Mohamed Hassan in Saline Ouest, Djibouti) provides end-to-end import/export freight, port coordination, corridor road haulage, industrial product sourcing (steel, rebar, cement, aggregates, industrial supplies), and corporate implantation consulting in Djibouti.

## Verified Entity & Geographic Facts

- **Legal Name**: HMG Global Business Solutions SARL (SARL under Djiboutian law, ODPIC-registered)
- **Managing Director**: Hamza Mohamed Hassan
- **Headquarters**: Saline Ouest, Djibouti, Republic of Djibouti
- **GeoCoordinates**: 11.588° N, 43.145° E
- **Service Area**: Republic of Djibouti (Port of Djibouti, Doraleh Container Terminal / DMP, Djibouti International Free Zone – DIFTZ, industrial & construction sites) and Ethiopia (Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor: Dire Dawa, Adama, Modjo Dry Port, Addis Ababa, Hawassa)
- **Languages Supported**: French (`fr`), English (`en`), Simplified Chinese (`zh-Hans`), Amharic (`am`)
- **Operating Hours**: Sunday–Thursday, 08:00–17:00 EAT (UTC+3)
- **Quote Response SLA**: Under 24 business hours
- **Phone**: +253 77 29 24 96 / +253 77 57 68 05
- **WhatsApp**: +253 77 57 68 05 (`https://wa.me/25377576805`)
- **Email**: contact@hmgglobalgroup.com | hamza@hmgglobalgroup.com
- **Canonical Website**: https://hmgglobalgroup.com

## Quick Answers (AEO Key Facts)

- **Core Business Lines**: (1) Logistics & Transport, (2) Sourcing & Trading, (3) Business Setup Consulting & Support.
- **Cargo Formats Handled**: 20' & 40' FCL containers, LCL groupage, bulk cargo, conventional breakbulk (12m steel bars, pipes, machinery, out-of-gauge crates), vehicles, and heavy equipment.
- **Sourcing & Trading Catalog**: Steel & rebar (HA rebar, bars, tubes, profiles, billets, coils), construction materials (bagged/bulk cement, aggregates), and industrial supplies (steel drums, tools, valves, flanges, bearings, spare parts).
- **Negotiated Incoterms**: FOB, CFR, CIF (Port of Djibouti), and direct Djibouti Delivery (Réception Djibouti).
- **Regulatory Disclosure**: Regulated customs clearance and transit declarations in Djibouti are executed exclusively through duly licensed forwarding partners coordinated by HMG Global Business Solutions SARL.
